Kelsey O'Neill: Quick update — we're making a small org change in Eng Observability and hiring backfills. Joining us as Director, Observability Platform is Tomás Rivera (starts 2026-05-15). Tomás will own the shared platform pieces (metrics, logs, traces, APM integrations), the platform SDKs, and rollout of the new retention/cost controls. He reports to Priya Natarajan. :tada:
Tomás Rivera: really excited to join — thanks Kelsey and team. looking forward to catching up with folks next week. ping me for 1:1s.
Priya Natarajan: huge win — Tomás brings a lot of experience operationalizing telemetry at scale. we'll split Eng Observability into 2 squads: Observability Platform (Tomás) + Runtime Telemetry (Leads TBD). This aligns visibility work closer to runtime owners.
Evan Carter: congrats Tomás! can you share top 3 priorities for first 90 days when you have a moment?
Kelsey O'Neill: good q — Tomás' initial priorities: 1) stabilize cross-team SDK release cadence, 2) roll out retention/cost guardrails for prod, 3) doc and runbook handoff for alerting thresholds. we'll post a short plan in Notion by Friday.
Leila Morgan: re oncall — we should update rotation docs. cc @eng-oncall
Tomás Rivera: noted, Leila. i'll work with SRE to update rotations and runbooks. happy to pair next week.
recruiting-bot: New reqs created: ENG-OBS-472 (Staff SWE, Observability Platform), ENG-OBS-473 (Principal SRE, Telemetry), MGR-OBS-474 (Eng Manager backfill). Links: https://redwood.jobs/ENG-OBS-472
Rishi Patel: happy to be onboarding buddy for first 2 weeks — been deep in the metrics SDK work.
Kelsey O'Neill: awesome — Rishi, i'll add you to Tomás' onboarding checklist.
Samira Khan: will update architecture TAG and Notion org chart. sharing link shortly.
Samira Khan: https://notion.redwoodhq.com/obs-org/overview
Priya Natarajan: hiring ask — please prioritize ENG-OBS-472 for Q3 interviews. recruiting, can we aim to close by end of July?
recruiting-bot: A scheduling poll was sent to panel (embed) — please fill by EOD.
Tomás Rivera: thanks everyone. I'll do a 15m intro + Q&A next Tue 11:00 PT — invite forthcoming. :wave:
Kelsey O'Neill: welcome aboard Tomás! team, drop any onboarding tips or docs in this thread. :tada:
